translation.title: Diclofenac Sodium Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for osteoarthritis, periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, elbow pain (tennis elbow, etc.), muscle pain, and post-traumatic swelling and pain.
translation.usage: Apply 1 cataplasm (pap) to the affected area once a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are a child under 18, in the third trimester of pregnancy or past the fifth month of pregnancy, breastfeeding, if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it, if you have or have had asthma or hypersensitivity reactions caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, or if you have peptic ulcer. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are in the first or second trimester of pregnancy, having difficulty conceiving or undergoing fertility testing, elderly, if you have bronchial asthma, or if you have or have had hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or sodium pyrosulfite (sulfite sensitivity). Do not use continuously for more than 2 weeks. Do not apply to the eyes, mucous membranes, or skin with lesions (exudative dermatitis, eczema, infected lesions, burns, wounds, etc.). Do not use an occlusive dressing without a doctor's supervision. While using this medicine, do not apply other diclofenac products or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs topically or use them orally. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are using new-quinolone antibacterials (enoxacin, etc.), loop diuretics (furosemide, etc.), thiazide diuretics, drugs that interfere with blood clotting (warfarin, etc.), antiplatelet agents (aspirin, etc.), selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, or serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors. Sometimes dermatitis, itching, redness, roughness, or irritation, photosensitivity reactions, swelling, skin peeling, eczema, dry skin, rarely blistering, pigmentation, or anaphylactic symptoms (hives, angioedema, difficulty breathing, etc.), serious skin reactions such as contact dermatitis, or serious gastrointestinal reactions including bleeding, ulcer, or perforation of the stomach or intestine may occur. If any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
